scaffolding: SharkBot: SimpleNamespace with only what the code touches. Destiny.Definitions.*.get returns definitions from a fixed catalog (_NODES, _RECORDS); Utils.JSON.dumps is json.dumps.
Fixed catalog: two ranks (Rookie, Veteran), one record set in each, three objectives, two of them with {var:...} in the description to exercise the extraction of variables.
The catalog is built by helper functions (_node, _record) instead of nested literals, so that the scaffolding does not trigger MNC on its own. Checked: Pysmell only flags the 8 lines of the snippet.
pinned_behavior: typical: two characters, picks the one with the most recent dateLastPlayed even when it comes later in the dictionary; output dictionary checked field by field, including variables from the profile and from the character; printed JSON equal to the return value.
edge: a single character, everything complete; ranks and sets marked as complete; combined variables; printed JSON equal to the return value.
invalid: an objective without a record in the API response raises KeyError.
not_pinned_on_purpose: The original changes the input dictionary (the |= merge records and profile variables into those of the character). The tests do not check this: it is an accidental side effect, and a refactoring that stops mutating the input should not fail because of it.
